author: Disney
description:
To kick off Teacher Appreciation Week, Disney is teaming up with DonorsChoose and Yvette Nicole Brown — voice of Lady Saddlespur in the new Disney+ and Disney Jr. series “Sofia the First: Royal Magic” to help sprinkle a little extra magic into select TK–1st grade classrooms across all 50 states and Washington DC! Thank you, teachers, for making learning special every day!
